title: Testing
explain: A test runs your code with known input and checks the result. Node ships a built-in test runner, and Vitest or Jest are popular alternatives with the same shape. Types make tests safer too, since a wrong argument fails to compile.
exercise: Write a `clamp(n, min, max)` function with three tests, including a value below the range.
tip: A test that never fails proves nothing. Break the code on purpose once to make sure the test notices.
